findings.detail: The extracted position sum omits the $62.471 million structured credit investment category, exactly equal to the conservation residual.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation is decisive. The filing schedule reports total investment fair value of $1.951269 billion, matching the companyfacts anchor, while the extracted 176-position sum is $1.888798 billion. Their $62.471 million difference exactly equals the raw-source Structured Credit Investments Total fair value at table 52 row 5, localizing the undershoot to an extraction gap for that investment category.
